newIdeas.name: Flex Ltd.
newIdeas.theme: Cloud + Power Infrastructure SpinCo · grid-to-chip AI infrastructure
newIdeas.thesis: The planned Q1 2027 spin of Cloud and Power Infrastructure could create one of the cleanest public power/thermal/data-centre infrastructure pure plays. CPI Q1 revenue was $2.2bn, +35% YoY, with 9.7% segment margin; management now expects CPI FY27 revenue growth of 65–75% and 80%+ growth in FY28.
newIdeas.catalysts: September Form 10, Nov 10 Investor Day, CPI backlog/ramp, Q1 2027 tax-free spin and clearer standalone valuation.
newIdeas.risks: AI/data-centre capex concentration, pre-spin execution, separation costs, valuation volatility and significant overlap with existing Power Stack grid/cooling exposure.
newIdeas.researchNote: Best additional spin-off setup found in this sweep. The underlying SpinCo directly targets the Power Stack's power + thermal + time-to-power bottleneck, while FLEX has already pulled back materially from its August high.

newIdeas.name: Textron
newIdeas.thesis: Textron is separating or selling its Industrial businesses so the remaining company becomes a cleaner aerospace/defense pure play around Textron Aviation, Bell and Textron Systems. Q2 revenue rose 3%, adjusted EPS rose, and combined Aviation/Bell/Systems backlog is substantial.
newIdeas.catalysts: Industrial sale/separation terms, Bell MV-75 execution, aviation orders and continued repurchases.
newIdeas.risks: Industrial transaction uncertainty, aviation cycle, defense program execution and weaker cash flow versus prior year.
newIdeas.researchNote: Good value-unlock setup but less asymmetric than FLEX/LHX because the separated Industrial asset itself is not the desirable Power Stack exposure.

newIdeas.name: MP Materials
newIdeas.thesis: The strongest liquid US rare-earth sovereignty vehicle: Q2 NdPr production +41%, sales +127%, price-protection support and positive Magnetics EBITDA give it more operating proof than pre-revenue developers.
newIdeas.catalysts: US government/offtake support, magnet ramp, NdPr pricing and non-China supply-chain investment.
newIdeas.risks: Government-policy dependence, rare-earth price volatility, execution and share count up ~8% YoY.
newIdeas.researchNote: Prefer MP over speculative Western rare-earth explorers, but Lynas currently has the stronger mature-profit profile.

newIdeas.name: Lynas Rare Earths
newIdeas.theme: Non-China rare-earth processing + magnet supply chain
newIdeas.thesis: The highest-quality current non-China rare-earth producer/processor in the queue. FY26 profit rose sharply, NdPr volumes increased and price-floor agreements plus US/Japan supply-chain policy improve strategic economics.
newIdeas.catalysts: New supply agreements, US magnet-chain buildout, Malaysian processing performance and sustained price floors.
newIdeas.risks: Mt Weld/Kalgoorlie execution, higher costs, CEO transition and rare-earth price normalization.
newIdeas.researchNote: Best fundamental rare-earth sovereignty exposure, though ASX access may make MP the more practical US-market vehicle.

critical-minerals-sovereignty.watchlistAction: LYC is the quality leader; MP is the more practical US-market sovereignty vehicle. Keep both above pre-revenue explorers.
